Subject: MAP intake & contracting cadence for Nebula Health

Hi Ava,

Great to meet you on the demo yesterday — thanks for the time. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have a shared intake on evaluation milestones and contracting ownership. I've attached a lightweight MAP template (Redwood_MAP_template_v1.xlsx) with the columns we'll use: milestone, owner, target date, success criteria.

To keep things moving I'd appreciate if you can confirm:
- Procurement contact who will own PO/payment terms
- Legal/contact who will own redlines and the preferred review method (tracked changes, redline tool, portal)
- Any internal cadence constraints (finance windows, month-end freezes)

Proposed high-level timeline we can iterate on:
- Security questionnaire + docs exchange: Sep 20–24
- Technical trial / perf evaluation: Oct 1–14
- Contract review & redlines: Sep 13–Sep 24 (two review cycles)
- Target signature / PO: on or before Oct 1

Can your team join a 30-minute kickoff on Thu Sep 9? I can do 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET or we can find a different slot. I'll add Marissa (contracts & commercial) and Diego (solutions) to keep the right owners in the loop.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_template_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra

- Procurement lead / PO: Ava Wilson (me) — procurement@nebulahealth.com
- Legal counsel (terms & redlines): Ellen Park (ellen.park@nebulahealth.com)
- Finance / payment window: Raj Singh (raj.singh@nebulahealth.com)

Our preferred redline process: initial redlines in Word (tracked changes) sent to Ellen; final execution via DocuSign once commercial is agreed. We also route major agreement changes through our procurement portal (link below) so please include the portal request id when you have an SOW draft. I've attached our PO requirements and an excerpt of our standard terms for your review (Nebula_PO_requirements.pdf).

Kickoff: Thu Sep 9 works for us. Would 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT be possible? If that slot is tight we can push to 11:30.

Thanks Rishi and Ava — adding a little more detail on the technical/eval side so we can lock acceptance criteria into the MAP.

Proposed evaluation milestones we will deliver:
- Eval environment provisioned (isolated tenant + sample keys): target Sep 20
- Baseline performance run (latency/cost) using your prompt set: Oct 2–4
- Feature test: streaming + function calling scenarios: Oct 5–7
- Security evidence handoff (logs, retention config, SOC notes): Sep 20–24

What we need from Nebula:
- Representative prompt set (10–20 examples) + expected success criteria
- Any IP/data exclusions for the trial
- Point of contact for SSO and network allowlisting

We can own the MAP sheet and update milestone status weekly. For the kickoff call, 11:00 AM ET on Sep 9 is fine for me; I can be on the call to map the perf targets and trial scope.

Regards,

Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Ava — appreciate the quick turnaround on owners. A couple of commercial/contracting milestones to propose so legal has clear SLAs for review:

- Nebula legal first pass (tracked changes): target Sep 17
- Redwood responds to redlines / revised SOW: Sep 20
- Final redline acceptance & DocuSign setup: Sep 24
- Target signature / PO issuance: on or before Oct 1

If Ellen prefers longer for the first pass please say so — we can relax the schedule by a week. We plan to include a short SLA excerpt in the first draft to avoid spin cycles; attaching a proposed excerpt now (Proposed_SLA_excerpt.docx).

Also: will Nebula accept HubSpot Deal notes and a shared Google MAP sheet for live updates? If yes I’ll share both links after this thread so everyone has edit access.
